_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-03. CardID = 17600 + idx; 309 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 9). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [309, 17629].

Restriction band (BIGFOOT, THE JACKALOPE or ANY) and copies (xN printed on each card) read from the images; type, value and boost match unmatched-memory for all 11 titles. Bigfoot's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles' and Doctor Strange's: only deck.identity (data/tts/bigfoot.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Restriction by card: BIGFOOT on Larger Than Life, Savagery and Crash Through the Trees; THE JACKALOPE on Jackalope Horns; ANY on the other seven titles (Disengage, Momentous Shift, Skirmish, Hoax, Regroup, Feint, It's Just Your Imagination).
Hero card (read from the image): BIGFOOT, MELEE, START HEALTH 16, MOVE 3; sidekick THE JACKALOPE, MELEE, START HEALTH 6 (the card prints the move once, 3, for both). One Jackalope.
The ability is an end_of_turn trigger on the interpreter (data/heroes/effects/bigfoot.json); no counters, forms or passives.
